Name: Legacy Community Center Bundles
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3w0k24j9/legacy-community-center-bundles.png[/img][/center][size=3][center]⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐

I always find myself rushing to complete the Community Center as quickly as possible, so I wanted to make some additional bundles that were a little more challenging, required ALL items to be submitted, and would require a bit more effort to complete. This would also slow down the speed in which it can be completed at the same time. This is the result!

Recommended if you would like a bit more of a challenge with the Community Center Bundles,
and for it to feel even more satisfying and rewarding to complete![/center][/size][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Jz12vRDN/Special-notes.png[/img][/center][size=3]⭐Some items can'[/size][size=3]t be submitted until Winter, and some recipes required can only be unlocked by raising your friendship with the towns people. Hopefully this will make it even more fun and challenging! 
[/size][size=3]
⭐The Vault and The Missing Bundle remain unchanged, and some vanilla default bundles are still present, but have been tweaked, as have some of the rewards! (See below for more information on the bundles and rewards)

⭐Make sure to start a new game and select 'Remixed Bundles' in the options, to ensure these bundles replace the default ones. 


[center]I hope you have fun with this![/center]

[/size]

[size=3]I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
